details.description: Dataset of the regions, departments, communes and postal codes of France, with one GPS point per postal code and the history of changes. Built from INSEE, La Poste, BAN and geo.api.gouv.fr.
Chrome extension that fixes a Chromium bug where the page layout doesn't reflow correctly to fit the viewport after a reload while DevTools is docked. No manual resize needed anymore.
Bash setup for Debian on WSL2: one file per topic, a git-aware prompt, and tooling that keeps secrets out of the shell and out of Git.
The regions, departments, communes and postal codes of France, with one GPS point per postal code: data, models and a loader for Laravel and Symfony.
Keep the job offers you saw and follow each application. Everything stays in your browser.
Custom Markdown parser written in PHP, extending the standard syntax to attach an ID and CSS classes directly to elements (e.g. # Title {#myId .class1 .class2}), designed for web use.
The quality tools of the zairakai PHP projects, without Laravel: Pint, PHPStan, Rector, PHP Insights, markdownlint and the Git hooks, as a base that a project extends.

PHP tool that extracts voice-over notes from PPTX files: unzips the archive, walks every slide (glob), and parses speaker comments via regex into a clean, structured PHP array grouped by speaker and reference, ready for further processing.
The quality tools of the JavaScript and TypeScript projects: ESLint, Prettier, Stylelint, Vitest, TypeScript and markdownlint configurations, as a base that a project extends.

Chrome extension that automatically switches your Microsoft Teams presence status based on a configurable weekly schedule. No admin permissions, no external script, runs entirely client-side in the browser.
